architectural_principles: A service owns its entities exclusively — no shared databases between services.
Cross-capability communication is async events only (via SVC-102 event bus). No synchronous cross-capability calls.
Same-capability services (within CAP-001) may communicate directly (synchronous API calls permitted).

SVC-002 (Mortgage Service) is a promoted sub-capability of CAP-001 (Retail Banking). It shares capability-level data access with SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core) but is a separate bounded context with its own entity ownership.
Event payloads carry minimum data required for consumers to act. No raw PII in event payloads beyond essential identifiers.

service_boundaries.description: Owns the end-to-end mortgage application lifecycle. Created as a promoted sub-capability of CAP-001. Holds all mortgage-specific entities. Communicates with SVC-001 (same capability) via direct API for customer data. Communicates with SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) and SVC-014 (KYC/AML, CAP-005) exclusively via async events through SVC-102.

consumed_events.communication_pattern: async — cross-capability boundary. SVC-002 subscribes via SVC-102 event bus.
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-002 receives the credit score and credit decision from the Risk Engine. Updates MortgageApplication with credit outcome. For DIP: if pass, proceeds to issue DIP (EVT-021). For full application: credit result stored for underwriter review. Idempotent on application_id + check_type (soft|hard).

synchronous_dependencies.purpose: SVC-002 calls SVC-001 GET /customers/{id} to fetch Customer data (name, address, date of birth) required for mortgage application, ESIS document generation, and offer issuance. No local copy of Customer fields maintained in SVC-002.

synchronous_dependencies.call_pattern: Asynchronous publish (event bus for all cross-capability events)
synchronous_dependencies.purpose: SVC-002 publishes all events to SVC-102 for routing to cross-capability consumers (SVC-012, SVC-014, SVC-017).
SVC-002 calls SVC-053 to dispatch customer notifications: DIP issued, full application received, valuation instructed, underwriting decision, mortgage offer, completion confirmation, welcome pack.

synchronous_dependencies.call_pattern: Async via SVC-012 (SVC-002 does not call credit bureau directly — credit check is requested via EVT-022 and result received via EVT-023)
synchronous_dependencies.purpose: Credit checks are fully mediated through SVC-012 (Risk Engine). SVC-002 has no direct integration with credit bureaux.

synchronous_dependencies.call_pattern: Synchronous API or portal instruction (SVC-002 instructed valuation directly)
synchronous_dependencies.purpose: SVC-002 instructs valuations directly via the surveyor panel management system. Surveyor panel is an external service managed by the Mortgage Operations team.

synchronous_dependencies.provider_service_name: CHAPS (Bank of England Real-Time Gross Settlement)
synchronous_dependencies.call_pattern: Synchronous — CHAPS payment instruction on completion day
synchronous_dependencies.purpose: SVC-002 submits the CHAPS payment instruction to release mortgage funds to the solicitor on completion day. CHAPS provides irrevocable same-day settlement.

service_boundaries.description: Provides credit scoring and risk assessment services. Consumed by SVC-002 exclusively via async events. SVC-012 receives CreditCheckRequested (EVT-022) from SVC-002, calls the credit bureau, and publishes CreditCheckCompleted (EVT-023) back to SVC-102.

consumed_events.communication_pattern: async — cross-capability boundary. SVC-012 subscribes via SVC-102 event bus.
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-012 receives a credit check request from SVC-002. Calls the credit bureau (Experian/Equifax/TransUnion) with customer identity data. Publishes CreditCheckCompleted (EVT-023) with the credit score, credit decision, and credit report reference. Supports both soft check (DIP, no bureau footprint) and hard check (full application, footprint recorded).

service_boundaries.cross_capability_note: All communication between SVC-002 and SVC-012 is exclusively via async events (EVT-022 → SVC-012, EVT-023 ← SVC-012). No synchronous calls across this CAP-001 / CAP-004 boundary.

service_boundaries.description: Provides KYC identity checks for new mortgage applicants who are not existing bank customers, and AML property source-of-funds checks required under MLR 2017 for property transactions. All communication with SVC-002 is via async events across the CAP-001 / CAP-005 boundary.

consumed_events.purpose: JRN-006: SVC-014 checks whether the customer_id is an existing bank customer with active KYC. If new customer, SVC-014 initiates KYC workflow. If existing customer with valid KYC, SVC-014 publishes KYCClearanceGranted (EVT-004) without requiring new CDD.
JRN-006: SVC-014 listens for full application credit check requests to trigger AML source-of-funds check on the property purchase amount. AML check runs in parallel with credit check.

service_boundaries.cross_capability_note: All JRN-006 communication between SVC-002 and SVC-014 is exclusively via async events across the CAP-001 / CAP-005 boundary. SVC-014 KYC result is returned via the existing EVT-004 (KYCClearanceGranted) / EVT-005 (KYCReferralRaised) / EVT-006 (SanctionsHitDetected) event pattern reused from JRN-001.

service_boundaries.description: Same-capability peer to SVC-002. SVC-002 may call SVC-001 directly (synchronous) to read Customer data. SVC-001 links MortgageAccount (ENT-016) to the customer's current Account (ENT-004) for direct debit purposes via the Bacs mandate reference. No entity ownership crosses between the two services.

integration_with_svc002.pattern: same-capability direct API call (SVC-002 calls SVC-001 GET /customers/{id})
integration_with_svc002.data_shared: Customer identity data (name, address, DOB) for ESIS and offer document generation
integration_with_svc002.no_reverse_call: SVC-001 does not call SVC-002 directly. SVC-001 consumes EVT-029 (MortgageCompleted) and EVT-030 (MortgageAccountOpened) from SVC-102 to update the Customer's product holdings record.

capability_boundary_map.description: Defines which service interactions cross capability boundaries and must be async, and which are within the same capability and may be synchronous.

events: EVT-030 (MortgageAccountOpened) consumed by SVC-001 via event bus
